newsitem.title: USA: Countrywide March funded loans top $3.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Countrywide March funded loans top $3.0 bln.

text.p: Countrywide Credit Industries Inc, a mortgage lender and servicer, on Friday said it funded $3.0 billion of mortgage loans in March 1997 and its loans in process totaled $5.1 billion at March 31.

The company said in a statement that its servicing portfolio increased to $160 billion at March 31, up 16 percent from the $138 billion at March 31, 1996. The portfolio had a weighted average coupon of 7.8 percent at the end of both March 1997 and 1996.
Countrywide's fixed-rate loan production amounted to $1.9 billion, or 65 percent of total production, in March 1997 and $3.2 billion, or 88 percent of total production, in March 1996.
Purchase mortgage activity was $1.9 billion in March 1997 and $1.8 billion in March 1996. Refinances represented 35 percent of total fundings in March 1997 compared to 51 percent in March 1996.
The company funded $97 million of home equity loans in March 1997 and $27 million in March 1996. Sub-prime loan funding activity was $89 million in March 1997 and $76 million in March 1996.
